meta_description: Oatlands Heating-Plumbing & Bathrooms in Woking. Emergency plumbing, boiler installation, and bathroom design. Fast response, honest pricing. Call now.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe or broken boiler in Woking? We arrive within the hour, any time of day or night.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Heating Services Across Woking
services_subhead: From emergency call-outs to full bathroom overhauls, we handle every aspect of domestic heating, plumbing, and bathroom installation.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing Repairs
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and blockages fixed fast. We carry parts on the van and aim to resolve most faults the same day.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Repair
services.desc: Full boiler replacement and system upgrades with 10-year guarantees. Emergency repairs covered 24/7, including breakdowns over Christmas.

services.title: Central Heating Service
services.desc: Annual servicing, radiator replacement, and system commissioning. Keep your heating running efficiently and cut your bills.

services.title: Bathroom Design & Installation
services.desc: Bespoke bathroom suites, wet rooms, and tile work from design to completion. Free consultation and quotes within 48 hours.

services.title: Drain & Unblocking Services
services.desc: Clear blocked sinks, toilets, and drains using CCTV drain surveys and high-pressure jetting. Same-day attendance available.

services.title: Tap & Valve Replacement
services.desc: Supply and fit modern taps, mixer showers, and isolation valves. All work covered by our 5-year warranty.

about_pullquote: We fix your problem properly the first time, not patch it to chase the next job.
about_para_1: Oatlands Heating-Plumbing & Bathrooms has served Woking, Weybridge, and the surrounding areas for over 18 years. Founded on the principle that honest pricing and reliable work build lasting customer relationships, we've completed more than 2,400 jobs across heating systems, emergency plumbing, and bathroom installations. Every team member is Gas Safe registered and trained to the latest industry standards.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on turning up on time, diagnosing faults accurately, and quoting fairly before we start work. We don't believe in surprise bills or unnecessary upsells. Whether you need an emergency call-out at midnight or a planned bathroom renovation, you'll work with the same people from start to finish—no subcontractors, no surprises.
reviews_heading: What Woking Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a nightmare with a leaking radiator just before Christmas. Called Oatlands on the off-chance they'd come out, and Mark was here within 45 minutes. Diagnosed the problem, quoted fair, and had it sorted by evening. Brilliant service. Will definitely use them again.
reviews.author: David K.

reviews.text: Complete bathroom renovation from design to tiling. The team were professional, tidy, and didn't rush the job. They explained everything as they went and actually listened to what we wanted. Highly recommend. No hidden costs either.
reviews.author: Jennifer W.

reviews.text: Called out for an emergency drain blockage on a Saturday morning. They came within an hour, used the CCTV camera to show me exactly what was wrong, and fixed it properly. Fair price, no faffing about. Top-notch service.
reviews.author: Simon T.
